capitulos.titulo: Designing and Managing Security Testing Processes

entradas.topic: What threat modeling is according to the manifesto
entradas.summary: Analyzing representations of a system to highlight security and privacy concerns.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: The four questions of threat modeling
terms_en: what are we going to do about it
did we do a good enough job
entradas.summary: 1 What are we working on? 2 What can go wrong? 3 What are we going to do about it? 4 Did we do a good enough job?
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Why do threat modeling; who should do it
entradas.summary: Recognize what can go wrong, find design and implementation problems; anyone concerned about privacy, security and safety.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: How to use the manifesto (methodology-agnostic, not a how-to)
entradas.summary: Guide for developing or refining a methodology; ideas, not a recipe; format inspired by the Agile Manifesto (values and principles).
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: The five values of the manifesto
entradas.summary: Culture of finding and fixing > checkbox; people > processes/tools; journey > snapshot; doing > talking; continuous refinement > single delivery.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: The four principles of the manifesto
entradas.summary: Early and frequent analysis; align with development practice in iterations of manageable scope; results of value to stakeholders; dialogue builds understanding and documents record it and enable measurement.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Patterns that help (Systematic Approach, Informed Creativity, Varied Viewpoints, Useful Toolkit, Theory into Practice)
entradas.summary: Five patterns recommended by the manifesto.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Anti-patterns (Hero, Admiration for the Problem, Overfocus, Perfect Representation)
entradas.summary: Four anti-patterns that hinder threat modeling.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: About the manifesto: intent, authors, license
entradas.summary: 15 authors; CC BY 4.0; current version on the manifesto website.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Book identification (Packt, MacMillan, 2021)
entradas.summary: Infosec Strategies and Best Practices, Joseph MacMillan, Packt, April 2021, ISBN 978-1-80056-635-4. Single author; not a DZone compilation.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Terminology: organization, information, CIA triad, non-repudiation
entradas.summary: CIA as an interconnected system; N = non-repudiation.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Definition of risk and the formula Risk = Impact x Likelihood
entradas.summary: Risk = potential for loss; components are assets, threats, vulnerabilities, likelihood and impact.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Assets and the asset register
entradas.summary: Asset = anything of value; no asset, no risk; register with ID, name, description, notes.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Threats and actors (solo, group, state, insider, environmental)
entradas.summary: Capability, interest, tactics; standard set: outsiders, malicious insiders, accidental insiders, environmental.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Vulnerability (simple definition)
entradas.summary: Weakness of the asset that a threat can exploit.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Impact and likelihood scales and the 5x5 matrix
entradas.summary: Impact by % of revenue; likelihood 1-5; 5x5 matrix (1-25).
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Risk appetite and treatment (avoid, reduce, transfer, accept)
entradas.summary: Level acceptable to the stakeholders; four treatments; residual below the acceptance level.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Compliance, privacy and ISO standards
entradas.summary: Laws and standards, certifications, compliance tools, internal audits.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Investigations, legal hold and eDiscovery
entradas.summary: Support investigations; pseudonymization avoids bias; eDiscovery.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Continuous improvement (RAID example)
entradas.summary: Simulation reveals gaps; updates records, reassesses risk, shows economic impact.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Training and awareness
entradas.summary: Train so as not to depend on a single person; do not blame the victim.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Third-party risk: SLA, VSAQ, due diligence
entradas.summary: Binding SLA as a control; security questionnaire; documented due diligence.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Defense in depth and progress reporting to management
entradas.summary: Defense in depth tolerates a control failure; keep versions of the risk register; report without jargon.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: Role of senior management and risk communication (business case)
entradas.summary: Final responsibility rests with senior management; template: loss, system, threat, mitigation, cost, deadline.
entradas.label: [from source]

entradas.topic: ISMS: definition and documents

entradas.topic: Data in transit, at rest, in use; encryption and hashing
